video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.19.2026

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Jarrett Allen's dedication and habits
quotes.excerpt: Jarrett Allen did a great job last year of getting another level of dedication with his habits.
quotes.quote: Play like it's Game 7 all the time. I think with Jarrett Allen, and he did a great job last year of getting another level of dedication with his habits, especially in the weight room. Jawad Williams was a part of that, staying on him and pushing him. So if he's in good physical condition and good mental space, he's a super talented player.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says Jarrett Allen has reached another level of dedication with his habits in the weight room. He believes that when Allen is in a good physical and mental space he is a super talented player.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Importance of teammates recognizing Jarrett Allen's role
quotes.excerpt: It's more important for our other players to know how important he is.
quotes.quote: It's more important for our other players to know how important he is. I think we talked a lot about that last year. We talked a lot about it as a team. Okay, he's going to do all these things, he's going to do all these connector things, role player things. Are we going to reward him for that? I know even in the playoffs it became a thing, like reward our big, him and Evan Mobley, really. It's super important with this team.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson emphasizes the importance of the Cavs rewarding Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley for the connector and role player things they do on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on identifying a stable rotation
quotes.excerpt: I have a good idea in my mind, but we just got to see how it plays out.
quotes.quote: I have a good idea in my mind, but we just got to see how it plays out with who's in and who's out. I've made that mistake before where I say, 'Hey, here's our rotation,' and a guy tweaks an ankle. So I'll probably wait up until game time.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson is holding off on finalizing his rotation until game time to account for potential injuries. He says he has learned not to commit to a set rotation too early.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the organization's next steps
quotes.excerpt: We're doing a lot of things behind the scenes too to push this thing forward.
quotes.quote: We're doing a lot of things behind the scenes too to push this thing forward. I think Dan Gilbert always says that, like it's a whole organization, it's like the community of the Cavs that push it forward. We obviously have a darn good team, but we really believe in the margins, what we're doing on the margins behind the scenes. I feel great about that. You feel when an organization is moving in the right direction with us, with the team.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are focused on the margins behind the scenes to push the organization forward. He feels great about the direction the team is moving.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on why 10 players is the right rotation size
quotes.excerpt: Because you truly don't know your team, the more guys you can play, the more feedback you get.
quotes.quote: Because you truly don't know your team, the more guys you can play, the more feedback you get. I think that's number one. And then opportunity. If you cut it right away to nine or eight, from a chemistry standpoint, connection standpoint, obviously the more guys you play, the more involved everybody is. And then an 11th guy knows he can get into 10. If a guy's out, I can slip into the rotation. We know we have to develop our depth. I think that's the last thing. Depth is vital in today's game.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson plans to run a 10-man rotation for the Cavs. He says the depth is vital in today's game and playing more guys provides better feedback and keeps the team connected.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on acclimating to the new role
quotes.excerpt: I'm still in an observation mode because it's a different role.
quotes.quote: I think it's still a work in progress. We are still working with him to define what that role is. I'm still in an observation mode because it's a different role. I can watch his Real Madrid game where he's a number one option and then watching us. We've had those discussions. I don't want to right off the bat put him in a box because I do not know his game well enough and how it fits the NBA. Obviously getting a better idea, but that's going to take some time to really narrow that down.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he is still in observation mode regarding a player's role and does not want to put him in a box yet. He notes that defining the role for an overseas player transitioning to the NBA will take time.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the transition of overseas players
quotes.excerpt: He's fitting great culturally, obviously coming back from a setback, injury setback.
quotes.quote: He's fitting great culturally, obviously coming back from a setback, injury setback. I love his spirit. And he's a guy I can speak French with. That's maybe the most important thing. I can practice my French and he can laugh at all the errors I make. That's a fun part of having him around.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says a new player is fitting in great culturally despite an injury setback. He joked that the best part is being able to practice his French with him.
